latest.title: Find a location on the map
latest.summary: The map gains a location finder: pick a kind and type, choose to rent, take over or buy, and get every available building ranked by neighbourhood demand and foot traffic, with estimated rent, deposit, door cap and rivals. Any building's card now shows its owner, renter, size, cap, traffic and rent. The Today card counts vacant units, a Growth cell jumps to premises for its type, and the Wiki explains how rent works.
